RandomX-in-the-browser is an *experiment*, not the VoltMiner product miner.

The Android app uses the bundled XMRig binary (MoneroOcean fork) speaking
TLS stratum to gulf.moneroocean.stream:20032 — RandomX native, DONATE 0%.

This folder holds a compiled WebRandomX (tevador/RandomX → Wasm) build:

  web-randomx.js     Emscripten glue (createWebRandomX, MODULARIZE)
  web-randomx.wasm   worker binary, INITIAL_MEMORY=272MB (heap, not file size)

Built from https://github.com/WebCryptomining/WebRandomX with Emscripten
4.0.10. CMake link flags were patched so the worker can find the hash
entry (upstream only exported _malloc/_free):

  -sMODULARIZE=1 -sEXPORT_NAME=createWebRandomX -sENVIRONMENT=worker
  -sEXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=_malloc,_free,_randomx_hash
  -sEXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=HEAPU8 -sINITIAL_MEMORY=272MB -sWASM_BIGINT=1

License of RandomX / WebRandomX is BSD-3-Clause. Do not hotlink a
third-party wasm at runtime.

The hop itself is tools/web-stratum-bridge on a VPS, not Cloudflare.
